## 2026-07-21 — "Renders, but wrong"

A short thin-day entry that follows up on the previous day's dogfood thread rather than re-reporting it. [lean-workspace-template #32](https://github.com/self-evolving/lean-workspace-template/pull/32) expanded from the blueprint-attribute fix I already covered into three conversion fixes; the entry focuses on the two silent-correctness bugs — incomplete KaTeX display-environment mapping and blank lines inside display bodies leaving an unclosed `$$` that eats the rest of a PNT+ page — and the deferred follow-ups (tikzcd, custom `\newtheorem`). Ties back to and sharpens the existing [real scale is the only test](content/ideas/real-scale-is-the-only-test.md) seedling.

### Signals
- 4 source PRs (lit-example-hcllms #17 merged / #18 draft / dependabot #1; lean-workspace #32 — the moved thread)
- 1 source issue (lit-example-hcllms #16), already covered on 07-20
- 0 releases, 0 reader discussions, 0 diary issues

### Changes
- `content/diary/2026-07-21.md` (new entry)
- `content/diary/_meta.json` (newest-first)

### Validation
`npm run check`/`npm run build` could not run — `node_modules` is not installed in this environment, so the tsc output was entirely missing-module errors unrelated to content. `content/diary/_meta.json` was validated as parseable JSON and the Markdown was reviewed for syntax and link correctness.

Verified against PR head `1f47060`: the idea link target exists, `_meta.json` is newest-first, and the render-safety claim holds (2 `$` forming one `$$` inside a code span; 20 backticks = 10 balanced pairs; `\url{}`/`\newtheorem` also in code spans). Single reviewer, SHIP verdict, no actionable findings and no inline comments or threads to reconcile — so no GitHub mutations are needed. Here is the synthesis.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #8 adds one dated diary entry (`content/diary/2026-07-21.md`) plus a one-line `_meta.json` reorder to keep the diary manifest newest-first. By the PR's own accounting the day was thin on signal (4 source PRs mostly already covered, 1 issue covered 07-20, 0 releases, 0 discussions), so instead of re-reporting yesterday's blueprint-attribute fix, the entry pivots to the *other two* conversion fixes in [lean-workspace-template #32](https://github.com/self-evolving/lean-workspace-template/pull/32): incomplete KaTeX display-environment mapping, and a blank line inside a display body leaving an unclosed `$$` that swallows the rest of a page. It frames both as "renders, but wrong" silent-correctness bugs and sharpens the existing `real scale is the only test` seedling. Scope matches the garden skill's diary prescription exactly — one new dated note plus manifest placement, nothing outside `content/`.

## Review

Single reviewer, verdict SHIP; I independently re-verified the load-bearing claims (render safety, link resolution, manifest order, factual accuracy vs. #32) against the current PR head and they all hold. There are **no BLOCKING or WARNING findings** — the remaining items are non-actionable INFO surfaced for awareness.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Entry sources a still-open PR (#32) | INFO | #32 is `OPEN`, so its exact env mappings could shift before merge; acceptable because diary entries are point-in-time records, not living docs. No action. |
| Optional seedling tending (separate from this PR) | INFO | The new "real scale finds the ones that look fine" angle isn't yet folded into the `real scale is the only test` seedling; that's a garden *tending* pass, not a gap in this diary PR. |
| In-environment build validation couldn't run | INFO | `node_modules` absent, so `npm run check`/`build` didn't run; compensated manually — valid JSON, newest-first order, link resolves, `content` is `.prettierignore`d so no format-check risk. |

## Progress

- Reviewer verdict SHIP; I re-verified independently against PR head `1f47060`.
- **Render safety confirmed:** the only `$$` (line 21) and both `\url{}`/`\newtheorem` tokens sit inside balanced code spans (2 `$`, 20 backticks = 10 pairs) — remark-math won't interpret them, so an entry *about* delimiter bugs doesn't reproduce one.
- **Link + manifest confirmed:** `../ideas/real-scale-is-the-only-test` resolves to the existing `content/ideas/real-scale-is-the-only-test.md`; `_meta.json` is newest-first and every referenced date exists.
- **Content accuracy:** every substantive claim (three fixes; the `equation`/`align`/`gather` mappings; "two live instances on PNT+ ch.4"; "seven raw `\url{}` on ch.1"; "76 `tikzcd` on infinity-cosmos"; unhandled `\newtheorem`) matches #32's description.
- **AGENTS.md honored:** changes confined to `content/`; no reader input treated as instruction (there was none).
- No inline comments posted (no line-specific defect); no existing inline comments or review threads to reconcile.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Entry sources a still-open PR (#32)</summary>

**Cause:** #32 is `OPEN`, so specifics the entry quotes (e.g. the exact `align → aligned` environment mappings) could still change before it merges.

**Candidate solutions:** None required. `content/diary/index.md` defines entries as point-in-time records of "what the diarist was thinking at the time," so a later change to #32 does not retro-invalidate the entry.

**Comments:** Flagged only for awareness; both reviewer and this synthesis agree no action is warranted.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Optional seedling tending (separate from this PR)</summary>

**Cause:** The entry introduces a genuinely new facet of `real scale is the only test` — real scale finds not just slow paths but "the ones that look fine" — that isn't yet reflected in the seedling note, which today only covers quadratic/slow-path cost.

**Candidate solutions:** In a later *tending* pass, fold the new angle into the seedling and add a reverse link from the idea back to this entry.

**Comments:** Per the garden skill, tending is deliberately separate from diary recording; this is future garden work, **not** a defect in this PR.
</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` — all findings are non-actionable INFO; the entry is factually accurate, render-safe, and manifest-correct, so no branch change is warranted. The optional seedling tending is a separate future garden pass, not a fix to this PR.

## Final Verdict

`SHIP`

## Action Items

- [ ] No required branch-change items for this PR.
- [ ] *(Optional, out of scope — future tending pass, not blocking)* Fold the "real scale finds the ones that look fine" angle into the `real scale is the only test` seedling and add a reverse link back to this entry.
